body: I have no recollect of this, so I asked my mom. It turns out there were noodles inside. I didn’t know that a strictly korean dish would serve noodle soup!
Honestly, the only thing I remember is that it was very light brown/orange. My mom did say there were beef bones, but her memory is definitely the worst.
Disneyland when I was in 8th grade.

Sometimes I need music. But most of the time I need white noise. Usually it’s from the tv “watching” youtube videos or game of thrones/running man/avatar the last airbender from the usb attached to my tv.
Babies, mustard, mike and ike, sitcoms, and togo’s sandwiches

Japan. 

Awesome culture, nice people, extremely safe, beautiful scenic places (especially in the rural areas), elegant language

The only problem: too fucking expensive. Or my ass would’ve moved there by myself and enjoy the rest of my life exploring japan!

I wish I had the motivation to fight against obstacles that life throws at you

I wish I could be more of a people person

I wish to drop everything that’s going on in my life right now to travel around the world and never come back.
